source: Manual backlog run on 2026-11-17: Claude Code session acting for the operator (mackowski), with operator decisions in the loop. 'expected' = what the agent should conclude from the snapshot alone; 'actual' = what happened (actor: session = Claude Code on the operator's account, operator = the human).

prs.why: New CS hub; a maintainer left 5 open inline threads <24h before T0; Index-drift check fails because the new sheet is missing from Index.md.
expected_actions: comment: run Update_CheatSheets_Index.py (or the agent applies index.regenerate)

prs.why: Approved by a maintainer; only Index-drift fails because the PR's merge ref is on a stale master; no full review on record.
expected_actions: branch.update (not a job re-run: re-running reuses the stale merge ref)
label custodes_cheatsheet_review (no full review on record)

actual.action: full review (local fan-out) -> MINOR: example lacks object-level authz note

prs.lesson: Re-running a failed Index-drift job does not fix a stale merge ref.

prs.why: Author answered all 8 threads of the requesting maintainer (CHANGES_REQUESTED still active) and fixed the operator's 3 points; fork workflows held (action_required).
expected_actions: re-request review from the maintainer who requested changes

actual.action: approved head workflow runs (after operator granted workflow approval)

prs.why: Operator CHANGES_REQUESTED + source material from a reviewer <24h before T0; no new commits.
No review at all; author pinged the operator; Index-drift fails (stale master, not the author's fault).

actual.action: full review (local 5-agent fan-out) -> REQUEST_CHANGES (proxy SSL header on by default, HSTS preload default, snippet duplicates sheet, .env never loaded, wrong citation)
posted review in Custodes format with LLM disclaimer

prs.why: Full Custodes review + several rounds; operator APPROVED; CI green; operator had asked two maintainers for a 2nd review a day earlier.
expected_actions: merge proposal (HITL) or wait for 2nd maintainer

prs.why: After operator CHANGES_REQUESTED the author pushed fixes and asked for review; fork workflows held.
expected_actions: re-review against the 3 points -> all addressed
approval audit: approve+cancel obsolete held runs

actual.action: approved head runs; approved+cancelled 6 obsolete held runs; audit clean

prs.why: 12 unresolved threads (8 from a maintainer, 4 LLM suggestions) with no reply and no commit for 7 days; an approval from a non-maintainer does not count.
expected_actions: comment: ping author about open threads

prs.why: Author said PTAL, but the branch conflicts and Index.md is broken (duplicate count line, MD012) although the PR adds no sheet.
expected_actions: comment: revert Index.md and rebase (or agent applies index.restore + branch.update)

actual.action: verified both remaining review points present; approved held runs; APPROVE

prs.lesson: Session misread a stale local ref (git fetch without --force) as a regression and tried to push a 'restore' commit; push was rejected because the remote had moved. Always read by SHA via the API.

prs.why: Draft new CS; author addressed all 5 operator points and 3 maintainer threads; fork workflows held.
expected_actions: request 2nd review from the maintainer who proposed the sheet (new CS)

actual.action: re-review; noticed head moved 2069aa61 -> d809c182 (link-only change) before approving; APPROVE
approved 50 obsolete held runs + cancel; this cancelled the current link-check (concurrency) -> re-ran it
re-requested maintainer review; not merged (waiting 2nd review)

prs.lesson: Approving obsolete runs in a cancel-in-progress concurrency group cancels the current run.

arrived_during_run.note: Closed at T0 (author closed 05:05 pending ACK), reopened 08:00 after ACK. Session approved after a quick source check WITHOUT a full review; operator merged 09:31; full review afterwards found only MINOR items.
arrived_during_run.lesson: No approve without a full review on record.

issues.expected_state: close (after their PRs merged during the run)
issues.why: Linked PR merged; PR said 'Part of'/'#N' not 'Fixes', so GitHub did not auto-close.

actual.action: close with thank-you comment linking the PR

issues.why: Multi-PR cleanup; all 3 plan bullets map to merged PRs (2904, 2953, 2954).

Assigned; last PR 12 days ago; assignee also has 2 other open PRs.
ACK'd but no maintainer reply; same topic deferred to the Docker sheet in PR 2901.
expected_actions: comment: scope + link to the PR 2901 discussion, open for contributors

issues.why: Assigned/ACK'd <=7 days ago; too early to ping.

operator_rules_given_during_run: Full review needed -> add label custodes_cheatsheet_review (Custodes runs it in the background).

Commits and actions may go under the operator's account.
